payload.title: Keep required-resource reach partitions within the required population
payload.summary: Priority2 retained-report correctness. build_analysis category_sets uses obligation_union minus global_reached for obligation_lane_only, but global_reached is already restricted to required resources while obligation_union includes every positive candidate. Tiny required.py plus unnecessary.py fixture misclassifies unnecessary.py as required-only. The retained original analysis.json/md actually reports413 obligation-only plus17 both for a17-resource required universe. This is an observed report-field defect, separate from authentic source/judgment binding and from valid global/own depth calculations.
payload.benefit: Preserve original analysis bytes and scientific judgments. Add a versioned read-only analysis verifier/corrected projection or explicitly versioned erratum that intersects every category with the authenticated required population. Verify categories disjoint, their union equals required exactly, every address/content pair belongs to the frozen frame, and counts equal rows. Independent tests for required/non-required overlap, no positive matches, global-only/own-only/both/neither, duplicate and foreign identities. Report original413 field as qualified, not silently repaired; independently authenticate original inputs and show unaffected original17/17 reach and completion-depth claims separately. No scientific rerun or gold relabeling.
payload.uncertainty: Original source and retained report confirm this specific arithmetic population error. Do not invalidate the whole case, infer task satisfaction, or alter frozen gates/results. Existing diagnostic prefix and Graph3 report-assurance bugs are different owners/contracts.
